content: This will delete your {{count}} expert agent and arbiter, then start a new setup conversation. The setup wizard itself will be preserved. This cannot be undone.

comment.text: Warning text in a modal dialog body describing the consequences of resetting the arbiter; {{count}} represents the number of expert agents.
